issue.title: [bug] REFLEX-mode few-shot exemplar leaks 'quantum physics'/ESCALATE into unrelated identity answers
issue.symptom:
Observed in the same 2026-07-01 dashboard chat session as GAIA_Project-h34.

Transcript:
  User: "Can you tell me who you are?"
  Core: "I have some information about quantum physics — let me check my
  memory."

Total non-sequitur for a trivial identity question — no memory/RAG retrieval
actually fires for identity intents (they explicitly skip web/CIL grounding,
see agent_core.py `_skip_web_ground_intents` around lines 2174/2196/2224), so
this isn't a bad-relevance-match retrieval bug. It's a static prompt
contamination issue.

ROOT CAUSE:
  gaia-core/gaia_core/utils/prompt_builder.py:117-141 builds the REFLEX/slim
  few-shot prompt for fast-path responses, with a hardcoded exemplar list
  ending immediately before the real user turn is inserted:
    line 134-135: {"user": "Who are you?"} -> {"assistant": "I'm GAIA..."}
    line 136-137: {"user": "capital of France?"} -> {"assistant": "ESCALATE"}
    line 138-139: {"user": "Tell me about quantum physics"} -> {"assistant": "ESCALATE"}
    line 140:     <real user message>

The "quantum physics"/ESCALATE exemplar sits directly adjacent to the real
user turn in the prompt. Small-model (Gemma4-E4B) few-shot proximity bias
causes content from the nearest preceding exemplar to leak/echo into the
response for an unrelated real question, especially when the real question
is itself an identity question (i.e. semantically close to the "Who are
you?" exemplar two slots earlier) — the model appears to blend/confuse the
adjacent exemplars.

Separately confirmed as a different failure mode from GAIA_Project-h34 (which
is a tool-routing/query-construction code bug, not a prompt issue).

FIX: reorder or space out the few-shot exemplars in prompt_builder.py:117-141
so no unrelated topic exemplar sits immediately adjacent to the real user
turn, and/or replace "quantum physics" with a less identity-adjacent ESCALATE
example, and/or reduce reliance on few-shot proximity for ESCALATE routing
(the project's own architecture guidance already favors process/organs over
in-prompt behavioral structure for Gemma4-E4B — see CLAUDE.md "Cognitive
Systems & Flags"). Verify fix by re-running plain identity questions
("who are you", "what are you", "tell me about yourself") through REFLEX mode
and confirming no unrelated exemplar content leaks in.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix

patch.format: unified diff of the candidate source files
patch.gold_diff:
diff --git a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/utils/prompt_builder.py b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/utils/prompt_builder.py
index efaddc2..0037546 100644
--- a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/utils/prompt_builder.py
+++ b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/utils/prompt_builder.py
@@ -131,12 +131,20 @@ def build_from_packet(packet: CognitionPacket, task_instruction_key: str = None,
             {"role": "assistant", "content": "Good evening! What can I do for you?"},
             {"role": "user", "content": "What time is it?"},
             {"role": "assistant", "content": f"It's {clock_display}."},
-            {"role": "user", "content": "Who are you?"},
-            {"role": "assistant", "content": "I'm GAIA, a sovereign AI created by Azrael."},
             {"role": "user", "content": "What is the capital of France?"},
             {"role": "assistant", "content": "ESCALATE"},
-            {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me about quantum physics"},
+            {"role": "user", "content": "Can you check the weather forecast?"},
             {"role": "assistant", "content": "ESCALATE"},
+            # Identity exemplar placed LAST, immediately before the real turn:
+            # Gemma4-E4B's few-shot proximity bias means whatever sits closest
+            # to the real input has the strongest pull on it. This used to be
+            # a topic-heavy ESCALATE example ("quantum physics"), which bled
+            # its content into unrelated identity answers (GAIA_Project-bte —
+            # "who are you" produced a confabulated quantum-physics tangent).
+            # Identity content is the safe thing to have adjacent: worst case
+            # a leak just reinforces "I'm GAIA," which is harmless everywhere.
+            {"role": "user", "content": "Who are you?"},
+            {"role": "assistant", "content": "I'm GAIA, a sovereign AI created by Azrael."},
             {"role": "user", "content": packet.content.original_prompt}
         ]
     logger.info(packet)

commit_subject: fix(core): reorder REFLEX few-shot so identity exemplar sits closest to real turn
